speaker: Narrator
text: The house is asleep. Only Sela moves, barefoot on the cold boards.

speaker: Sela
text: Sela folds two dresses into a travelling bag, counts the coins she has hidden in her shoe, and whispers to herself, "By dawn I'll be on the coast road, and he will never find me."

speaker: Narrator
text: Downstairs the old clock ticks on.
